name: New England Shrimp Rolls with Quick-Pickled Veggie Salad

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
2 sticks celery
2 English cucumbers
1 pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 680 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add mayo, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the aioli.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallot and add to the bowl with the aioli.
Mince celery and add to the bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Once the water in the saucepan comes to a boil, uncover, add shrimp, and stir for a few seconds. Remove from heat, and let sit until cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp honey
2 tsp Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, quarter, and thinly slice the other shallot and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumbers; quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Place corn in a clean colander and run under cold water to thaw. Pat dry with paper towels and transfer to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns, if desired, and spread with butter.
Drain the shrimp and discard the liquid. Rinse the shrimp under cold water to cool and pat dry with paper towels. Cut into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the aioli; toss to coat.
To serve, fill rolls with shrimp and sprinkle with paprika. Divide rolls and salad between plates. Enjoy!
